######################## Species aggregation ###################################################

aggregate_to_species <- function(phy) {

  otu_table_extracted <- otu_table(phy)
  tax_table_extracted <- tax_table(phy)
  sample_data_new     <- sample_data(phy)

  otu_df <- as(otu_table_extracted, "matrix") %>%
    as.data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    rownames_to_column("OTU")

  # --- Retrieves Species rank via OTU ---
  species_names <- tax_table_extracted[otu_df$OTU, "Species"]
  species_names <- as.character(species_names)

  # NA / empty -> Unassigned
  species_names[is.na(species_names) | trimws(species_names) == ""] <- "Unassigned"
  species_names <- trimws(species_names)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1) unique identifier by "Unknown" 
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  is_unknown_species <- function(x) grepl("^unknown\\s*species$", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  is_unknown_only    <- function(x) grepl("^unknown$", x, ignore.case = TRUE)

  idx_us <- which(is_unknown_species(species_names))
  if (length(idx_us) > 0) {
    species_names[idx_us] <- paste0("Unknown Species", seq_along(idx_us))
  }

  idx_u <- which(is_unknown_only(species_names))
  if (length(idx_u) > 0) {
    species_names[idx_u] <- paste0("Unknown", seq_along(idx_u))
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2) unique identifier by "X sp."
  #    Ex: "Wolbachia sp." -> "Wolbachia sp. 1", "Wolbachia sp. 2", ...
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # find "sp." at the end of value
  is_sp_plain <- function(x) grepl("\\bsp\\.?\\s*$", x, ignore.case = TRUE)

  idx_sp <- which(is_sp_plain(species_names))
  if (length(idx_sp) > 0) {

    # base = everything before "sp."
    base_name <- function(x) {
      sub("\\s+sp\\.?\\s*$", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE) %>% trimws()
    }

    bases <- base_name(species_names[idx_sp])
    unique_bases <- unique(bases)

    for (b in unique_bases) {
      rows_b <- idx_sp[bases == b]
      # unique identifier 1..n
      species_names[rows_b] <- paste0(b, " sp. ", seq_along(rows_b))
    }
  }

  # replace otu_df
  otu_df$Species <- species_names
  

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3) Aggregation at Species rank
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  otu_agg <- otu_df %>%
    dplyr::select(-OTU) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Species) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
    as.data.frame()

  rownames(otu_agg) <- otu_agg$Species
  otu_agg <- otu_agg[, -which(names(otu_agg) == "Species")]

  otu_new <- otu_table(as.matrix(otu_agg), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4) Rebuild tax_table (one line by Species)
  #    
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  tax_df <- as(tax_table_extracted, "matrix") %>%
    as.data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  # homogeneization of species name
  tax_df$Species <- as.character(tax_table_extracted[rownames(tax_df), "Species"])
  tax_df$Species[is.na(tax_df$Species) | trimws(tax_df$Species) == ""] <- "Unassigned"
  tax_df$Species <- trimws(tax_df$Species)
 
  # apply the same transformation on tax_df$Species with same OTU order
  # to be coherent
  # => we map OTU -> new species label
  map_otu_to_new_species <- setNames(species_names, otu_df$OTU)
  tax_df$Species <- map_otu_to_new_species[rownames(tax_df)]
  View(tax_df)

  tax_filtered <- tax_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Species %in% rownames(otu_new)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Species, .keep_all = TRUE)

  rownames(tax_filtered) <- tax_filtered$Species
  tax_filtered <- tax_filtered[rownames(otu_new), , drop = FALSE]

  tax_new <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax_filtered))

  merge_phyloseq(otu_new, sample_data_new, tax_new)
}

####################################### Summary counts after species collapsing ###################################

report_species_counts <- function(phy, dataset_name = "dataset") {

  phy_species <- aggregate_to_species(phy)

  # Taxa names = "Species labels" après collapse
  all_species <- taxa_names(phy_species)
  n_total_species <- length(all_species)

  # Count every "Unknown*"
  is_unknown_species_prefix <- function(x) {
    !is.na(x) & grepl("^Unknown", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  }
  n_unknown_species <- sum(is_unknown_species_prefix(all_species))

  # Subset Native / Invasive
  phy_native   <- subset_samples(phy_species, Category == "Native")
  phy_invasive <- subset_samples(phy_species, Category == "Invasive")

  # Matrices abondance
  otu_native   <- as(otu_table(phy_native), "matrix")
  otu_invasive <- as(otu_table(phy_invasive), "matrix")

  # does taxa = rows?
  if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_native)) {
    otu_native   <- t(otu_native)
    otu_invasive <- t(otu_invasive)
  }

  # detected species (sum > 0)
  species_native   <- rownames(otu_native)[rowSums(otu_native) > 0]
  species_invasive <- rownames(otu_invasive)[rowSums(otu_invasive) > 0]

  n_native   <- length(species_native)
  n_invasive <- length(species_invasive)

  # Visualization
  cat("\n==============================\n")
  cat("Dataset:", dataset_name, "\n")
  cat("Total 'species' after collapsing:", n_total_species, "\n")
  cat("Number of 'Unknown Species*':", n_unknown_species, "\n")
  cat("Detected in Native:", n_native, "\n")
  cat("Detected in Invasive:", n_invasive, "\n")
  cat("==============================\n")

  return(data.frame(
    Dataset = dataset_name,
    Total_species_collapsed = n_total_species,
    Unknown_Species = n_unknown_species,
    Species_detected_native = n_native,
    Species_detected_invasive = n_invasive,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}



# ---- apply to both dataset ----
counts_16S <- report_species_counts(phy16S, "Bacteriome (16S)")
counts_ITS <- report_species_counts(phyOL4, "Mycobiome (ITS)")


####################################### Specific OTU Invasive ###################################

# Function for  Invasive specific OTUs identifications
get_invasive_specific_species <- function(phy) {
  phy_species <- aggregate_to_species(phy)

  phy_native   <- subset_samples(phy_species, Category == "Native")
  phy_invasive <- subset_samples(phy_species, Category == "Invasive")

  otu_native   <- as(otu_table(phy_native), "matrix")
  otu_invasive <- as(otu_table(phy_invasive), "matrix")

  if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_native)) {
    otu_native   <- t(otu_native)
    otu_invasive <- t(otu_invasive)
  }

  otu_native   <- otu_native[rowSums(otu_native) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  otu_invasive <- otu_invasive[rowSums(otu_invasive) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

  species_native   <- rownames(otu_native)
  species_invasive <- rownames(otu_invasive)

  # --- Helpers ---
  # sp-num : accept "sp. 3" (16S) and "_sp. 3" (OL4)
  is_sp_num <- function(x) !is.na(x) & grepl("(\\bsp\\.|_sp\\.)\\s*\\d+$", x)

  # extract what is before "sp. X"
  sp_prefix <- function(x) {
    sub("(\\bsp\\.|_sp\\.)\\s*\\d+$", "", x) %>% trimws()
  }

  # Unknown Species*
  is_unknown_species_prefix <- function(x) !is.na(x) & grepl("^Unknown[ _.-]*Species", x, ignore.case = TRUE)

  # Unknown* but not Unknown Species*
  is_unknown_prefix <- function(x) !is.na(x) & grepl("^Unknown", x, ignore.case = TRUE) & !is_unknown_species_prefix(x)

  native_has_unknown_species <- any(is_unknown_species_prefix(species_native))
  native_has_unknown         <- any(is_unknown_prefix(species_native))

  # what is before "sp." detectable in natives (to compare) ?
  native_sp_prefixes <- unique(sp_prefix(species_native[is_sp_num(species_native)]))

  specific_flags <- vapply(species_invasive, function(s) {

    # 1) Unknown Species*
    if (is_unknown_species_prefix(s)) return(!native_has_unknown_species)

    # 2) Unknown* (but not Unknown Species*)
    if (is_unknown_prefix(s)) return(!native_has_unknown)

    # 3) normal cases
    if (!is_sp_num(s)) return(!(s %in% species_native))

    # 4) Cases sp-num : non-specific if same prefix before sp. is detected in natives
    pref <- sp_prefix(s)
    return(!(pref %in% native_sp_prefixes))

  }, logical(1))

  species_specific <- species_invasive[specific_flags]

  return(list(
    species_native   = species_native,
    species_invasive = species_invasive,
    species_specific = species_specific,
    phy_species      = phy_species
  ))
}

############# Abundance of Specific species invasive ################################

prepare_combined_specific_data <- function(phylo_obj, specific_species, dataset_name) {
  phylo_obj <- microbiome::transform(phylo_obj, "compositional")

  otu  <- as(otu_table(phylo_obj), "matrix")
  tax  <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phylo_obj))
  meta <- as(sample_data(phylo_obj), "data.frame") %>%
    rownames_to_column("SampleID")

  # Build an empty data.frame with the good structure 
  make_empty_df <- function() {
    meta %>%
      dplyr::slice(0) %>%                      
      dplyr::mutate(
        Abundance = numeric(0),
        OTU       = character(0),
        Dataset   = character(0)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(SampleID, Abundance, OTU, Dataset, dplyr::everything())
  }

  # if there isn't specific Species → message
  if (length(specific_species) == 0) {
    message("No specific species in invasives for dataset ", dataset_name)
    return(make_empty_df())
  }

  tax$Species[is.na(tax$Species) | tax$Species == ""] <- "Unassigned"
  otu_to_species <- tax$Species
  names(otu_to_species) <- rownames(tax)

  data_list <- list()

  for (sp in specific_species) {
    otu_ids <- names(otu_to_species)[otu_to_species == sp]
    if (length(otu_ids) == 0) next

    otu_subset <- otu[otu_ids, , drop = FALSE]
    abundance <- if (is.vector(otu_subset)) otu_subset else colSums(otu_subset)

    df <- data.frame(
      SampleID = names(abundance),
      Abundance = abundance,
      OTU = sp,
      Dataset = dataset_name,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    data_list[[sp]] <- df
  }

  # If specific species are detcted but abundance < 0 or other problem -> message
  if (length(data_list) == 0) {
    message("No specific species with non-zero abundance in invasives for dataset ", dataset_name)
    return(make_empty_df())
  }

  all_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(data_list) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(meta, by = "SampleID") %>%
    dplyr::filter(Category == "Invasive", Abundance > 0)

  # if filtering empty all → we keep the structure
  if (nrow(all_data) == 0) {
    message("All specific species have zero abundance in invasive samples for dataset ", dataset_name)
    return(make_empty_df())
  }

  return(all_data)
}

# ========== Apply to both dataset ==========
df_16S <- prepare_combined_specific_data(species_16S$phy_species, species_16S$species_specific, "Bacteriome")
df_OL4 <- prepare_combined_specific_data(species_OL4$phy_species, species_OL4$species_specific, "Mycobiome")
df_all <- bind_rows(df_16S, df_OL4)

#Axis x and OTU legend in italic
df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(HostSpeciesLabel = paste0("italic('", HostSpecies, "')"))
df_all$HostSpeciesLabel <- factor(df_all$HostSpeciesLabel, levels = unique(df_all$HostSpeciesLabel))

df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(OTULabel = paste0("italic('", OTU, "')"))

# creat labels
otu_levels <- unique(df_all$OTU)
otu_labels <- paste0("italic('", otu_levels, "')")

# Order the factor
df_all$OTU <- factor(df_all$OTU, levels = otu_levels)

# fixe order
otu_labels <- unique(df_all$OTULabel)                
df_all$OTULabel <- factor(df_all$OTULabel, levels = otu_labels)

# Palette: same number of color than levels
pal <- c("#7B241C", "#C1440E", "#FFA500", "#6A0DAD", "#22427C", "darkgreen")
pal <- rep(pal, length.out = length(otu_labels))
names(pal) <- otu_labels

# ========== Build general graphics with vertical facets ==========
library(scales)  # for log10 breaks

set.seed(42)
jwidth <- 0.5
lvl <- levels(df_all$HostSpeciesLabel)
df_all$x_id  <- as.integer(df_all$HostSpeciesLabel)                  # 1,2,3…
df_all$x_jit <- df_all$x_id + runif(nrow(df_all), -jwidth, jwidth)   # jitter fixe

# -- calibrating for pseudo-log (Keep 0 and extend lower part) --
min_pos <- suppressWarnings(min(df_all$Abundance[df_all$Abundance > 0], na.rm = TRUE))
if (!is.finite(min_pos)) min_pos <- 1e-6
sigma <- min_pos / 3  

# 2) build graphics using x_jit for points + labels
final_plot <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x = x_jit, y = Abundance, color = OTULabel, shape = Locality)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = SampleID),
    direction = "y",
    box.padding = 0.25, point.padding = 0.05,
    min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.25, segment.alpha = 0.6,
    force = 0.1, force_pull = 0.5, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # X Axes with labels in italic
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(lvl),
    labels = function(i) parse(text = lvl[i])
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.5, length(lvl) + 0.5)) +

  # >>> Visualization of Y : same values, space pseudo-log, 1st graduation forced, Scientific labels without repetition <<<
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = function(lims) {
      lo <- lims[1]; hi <- lims[2]
      base  <- scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)(c(lo, hi))
      first <- if (lo > 0) signif(lo, digits = 1) else 0
      sort(unique(c(0, first, base)))
    },
    labels = function(x) {
      lab <- ifelse(x == 0, "0", format(x, scientific = TRUE, digits = 6))
      lab
    }
  ) +
  coord_trans(y = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = sigma)) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = pal, breaks = otu_labels, labels = parse(text = otu_labels),
    guide  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Dataset, ncol = 2, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance", color = "OTU", shape = "Locality") +
  theme(
    strip.text   = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(face = "italic")))

# finale export
ggsave("Combined_Abundance_Specific_Species_16S_OL4.pdf", final_plot, width = 12, height = 8)

# Function for Natives specific OTUs identifications
get_native_specific_species <- function(phy) {
  phy_species <- aggregate_to_species(phy)

  phy_native   <- subset_samples(phy_species, Category == "Native")
  phy_invasive <- subset_samples(phy_species, Category == "Invasive")

  otu_native   <- as(otu_table(phy_native), "matrix")
  otu_invasive <- as(otu_table(phy_invasive), "matrix")

  if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_native)) {
    otu_native   <- t(otu_native)
    otu_invasive <- t(otu_invasive)
  }

  otu_native   <- otu_native[rowSums(otu_native) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  otu_invasive <- otu_invasive[rowSums(otu_invasive) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

  species_native   <- rownames(otu_native)
  species_invasive <- rownames(otu_invasive)

  # --- Helpers ---
  is_sp_num <- function(x) !is.na(x) & grepl("(\\bsp\\.|_sp\\.)\\s*\\d+$", x)

  sp_prefix <- function(x) {
    sub("(\\bsp\\.|_sp\\.)\\s*\\d+$", "", x) %>% trimws()
  }

  is_unknown_species_prefix <- function(x) !is.na(x) & grepl("^Unknown[ _.-]*Species", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  is_unknown_prefix <- function(x) !is.na(x) & grepl("^Unknown", x, ignore.case = TRUE) & !is_unknown_species_prefix(x)

  invasive_has_unknown_species <- any(is_unknown_species_prefix(species_invasive))
  invasive_has_unknown         <- any(is_unknown_prefix(species_invasive))

  # Prefixes sp. detected in invasives
  invasive_sp_prefixes <- unique(sp_prefix(species_invasive[is_sp_num(species_invasive)]))

  specific_flags <- vapply(species_native, function(s) {

    # 1) Unknown Species*
    if (is_unknown_species_prefix(s)) return(!invasive_has_unknown_species)

    # 2) Unknown* (but not Unknown Species*)
    if (is_unknown_prefix(s)) return(!invasive_has_unknown)

    # 3) Normal cases
    if (!is_sp_num(s)) return(!(s %in% species_invasive))

    # 4) Cases sp-num : non specific if same prefix sp. is detected in invasives
    pref <- sp_prefix(s)
    return(!(pref %in% invasive_sp_prefixes))

  }, logical(1))

  species_specific <- species_native[specific_flags]

  return(list(
    species_native   = species_native,
    species_invasive = species_invasive,
    species_specific = species_specific,
    phy_species      = phy_species
  ))
}

############# Abundance of Specific species native ################################

prepare_combined_specific_data_native <- function(phylo_obj, specific_species, dataset_name) {
  phylo_obj <- microbiome::transform(phylo_obj, "compositional")

  otu  <- as(otu_table(phylo_obj), "matrix")
  tax  <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phylo_obj))
  meta <- as(sample_data(phylo_obj), "data.frame") %>%
    rownames_to_column("SampleID")

  # Build empty data.frame with good structure
  make_empty_df <- function() {
    meta %>%
      dplyr::slice(0) %>%                      
      dplyr::mutate(
        Abundance = numeric(0),
        OTU       = character(0),
        Dataset   = character(0)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(SampleID, Abundance, OTU, Dataset, dplyr::everything())
  }

  # If no specific species → message + df vide
  if (length(specific_species) == 0) {
    message("No specific species in natives for dataset ", dataset_name)
    return(make_empty_df())
  }

  tax$Species[is.na(tax$Species) | tax$Species == ""] <- "Unassigned"
  otu_to_species <- tax$Species
  names(otu_to_species) <- rownames(tax)

  data_list <- list()

  for (sp in specific_species) {
    otu_ids <- names(otu_to_species)[otu_to_species == sp]
    if (length(otu_ids) == 0) next

    otu_subset <- otu[otu_ids, , drop = FALSE]
    abundance <- if (is.vector(otu_subset)) otu_subset else colSums(otu_subset)

    df <- data.frame(
      SampleID = names(abundance),
      Abundance = abundance,
      OTU = sp,
      Dataset = dataset_name,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    data_list[[sp]] <- df
  }

  # if there is no data for specific species (problem) -> message
  if (length(data_list) == 0) {
    message("No specific species with non-zero abundance in natives for dataset ", dataset_name)
    return(make_empty_df())
  }

  all_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(data_list) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(meta, by = "SampleID") %>%
    dplyr::filter(Category == "Native", Abundance > 0)

  # Si le filtre enlève tout → on garde quand même la structure cohérente
  if (nrow(all_data) == 0) {
    message("All specific species have zero abundance in native samples for dataset ", dataset_name)
    return(make_empty_df())
  }

  return(all_data)
}

  otu_fungi
)

pal_native <- c(pal_bact, pal_fungi)


  library(scales)

  set.seed(42)
  jwidth <- 0.5
  lvl_native <- levels(df_all_native$HostSpeciesLabel)
  df_all_native$x_id  <- as.integer(df_all_native$HostSpeciesLabel)
  df_all_native$x_jit <- df_all_native$x_id + runif(nrow(df_all_native), -jwidth, jwidth)

  # -- sigma calibration for pseudo-log --
  min_pos_native <- suppressWarnings(min(df_all_native$Abundance[df_all_native$Abundance > 0], na.rm = TRUE))
  if (!is.finite(min_pos_native)) min_pos_native <- 1e-6
  sigma_native <- min_pos_native / 3

  final_plot_native <- ggplot(df_all_native,
                              aes(x = x_jit, y = Abundance, color = OTULabel, shape = Locality)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(lvl_native),
      labels = function(i) parse(text = lvl_native[i])
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.5, length(lvl_native) + 0.5)) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = function(lims) {
        lo <- lims[1]; hi <- lims[2]
        base  <- scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)(c(lo, hi))
        first <- if (lo > 0) signif(lo, digits = 1) else 0
        sort(unique(c(0, first, base)))
      },
      labels = function(x) {
        lab <- ifelse(x == 0, "0", format(x, scientific = TRUE, digits = 6))
        lab
      }
    ) +
    coord_trans(y = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = sigma_native)) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = pal_native, breaks = otu_labels_native, labels = parse(text = otu_labels_native),
      guide  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Dataset, ncol = 2, scales = "free") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance", color = "OTU", shape = "Locality") +
    theme(
      strip.text   = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10)
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, label.theme = element_text(face = "italic")))


  ggsave("Combined_Abundance_Specific_Species_NATIVE_16S_OL4.pdf",
         final_plot_native, width = 12, height = 8)
}


#############################################################################################
############################# Summary table ################################################
############################################################################################

build_specific_summary <- function(phy_species, specific_species,
                                   specific_category, dataset_name) {

  empty_df <- function() {
    data.frame(
      Dataset           = character(0),
      Specific_category = character(0),
      Species           = character(0),
      Family            = character(0),
      Abundance_max     = numeric(0),
      Abundance_min     = numeric(0),
      Prevalence        = numeric(0),
      Host_species      = character(0),
      stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (length(specific_species) == 0) {
    message("No specific species for ", specific_category,
            " in dataset ", dataset_name)
    return(empty_df())
  }

  meta_all <- as(sample_data(phy_species), "data.frame")
  meta_all$SampleID <- rownames(meta_all)

  samples_keep <- meta_all$SampleID[meta_all$Category == specific_category]

  if (length(samples_keep) == 0) {
    message("No samples in category ", specific_category,
            " for dataset ", dataset_name)
    return(empty_df())
  }

  phy_cat <- prune_samples(samples_keep, phy_species)
  phy_cat <- microbiome::transform(phy_cat, "compositional")

  otu <- as(otu_table(phy_cat), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_cat)) {
    otu <- t(otu)
  }

  meta <- as(sample_data(phy_cat), "data.frame")

  species_in_otu <- intersect(rownames(otu), specific_species)

  if (length(species_in_otu) == 0) {
    message("Specific species not found in OTU table for ",
            specific_category, " in dataset ", dataset_name)
    return(empty_df())
  }

  # ---- Mapping Species -> Family came from tax_table ----
  tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_cat))
  View(tax)
  if ("Order" %in% colnames(tax)) {
    fam_map <- as.character(tax$Order)
    fam_map[is.na(fam_map) | fam_map == ""] <- "Unassigned"
    names(fam_map) <- rownames(tax)  # rownames = taxa names = Species (after collapsing)
  } else {
    fam_map <- setNames(rep("Unassigned", nrow(tax)), rownames(tax))
  }

  n_samples_cat <- ncol(otu)

  res_list <- lapply(species_in_otu, function(sp) {

    vec <- otu[sp, ]
    if (is.null(dim(vec))) {
      vec <- matrix(vec, nrow = 1,
                    dimnames = list(sp, colnames(otu)))
    }
    vec <- as.numeric(vec)

    present <- vec > 0
    if (!any(present)) return(NULL)

    abund_max <- max(vec[present], na.rm = TRUE)
    abund_min <- min(vec[present], na.rm = TRUE)

    n_present <- sum(present)
    prevalence <- n_present / n_samples_cat

    host_species_present <- unique(meta$HostSpecies[present])
    host_species_present <- sort(host_species_present)
    host_species_str <- paste(host_species_present, collapse = "; ")

    fam <- fam_map[[sp]]
    if (is.null(fam) || is.na(fam) || fam == "") fam <- "Unassigned"

    data.frame(
      Specific_category = specific_category,
      Dataset           = dataset_name,
      Species           = sp,
      Order            = fam,
      Abundance_max     = abund_max,
      Abundance_min     = abund_min,
      Prevalence        = prevalence,
      Host_species      = host_species_str,
      stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
    )
  })

  res <- dplyr::bind_rows(res_list)

  # Prevalence in decreasing order and then abundance max in decreasing order
  res <- res %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Prevalence),
                   dplyr::desc(Abundance_max),
                   Species)

  return(res)
}




# ---------- 16S: Invasive specific ----------
summary_16S_invasive <- build_specific_summary(
  phy_species       = species_16S$phy_species,
  specific_species  = species_16S$species_specific,
  specific_category = "Invasive",
  dataset_name      = "Bacteriome"
)

# ---------- 16S: Native specific ----------
summary_16S_native <- build_specific_summary(
  phy_species       = species_native_16S$phy_species,
  specific_species  = species_native_16S$species_specific,
  specific_category = "Native",
  dataset_name      = "Bacteriome"
)

# ---------- ITS / OL4: Invasive specific ----------
summary_ITS_invasive <- build_specific_summary(
  phy_species       = species_OL4$phy_species,
  specific_species  = species_OL4$species_specific,
  specific_category = "Invasive",
  dataset_name      = "Mycobiome"
)

# ---------- ITS / OL4: Native specific ----------
summary_ITS_native <- build_specific_summary(
  phy_species       = species_native_OL4$phy_species,
  specific_species  = species_native_OL4$species_specific,
  specific_category = "Native",
  dataset_name      = "Mycobiome"
)

# ---------- merged by data set + global ----------
summary_native_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(summary_16S_native, summary_ITS_native)
summary_invasive_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(summary_16S_invasive, summary_ITS_invasive)
summary_all     <- dplyr::bind_rows(summary_native_all, summary_invasive_all)

writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    All_specific_taxa       = summary_all,
    Native_specific = summary_native_all,
    Invasive_specific  = summary_invasive_all
  ),
  path = "Specific_taxa_summary(unknown_treatment).xlsx"
)
